notes: SwornToken (src/SwornToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20: name Sworn, symbol SWORN, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 SWORN (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which in the launch is the factory. totalSupply is an immutable; there is no mint, burn, owner, pause, blacklist, fee or tax on transfer, upgradeability, external call, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Every transfer moves exactly the amount it says, so the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the distributor's claim transfers, the pool seed and trader swaps through the PoolManager are exact without any exemptions. The launch deploys no application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply, and pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
